article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Democratic Republic of the Congo: Community engagement vital for effective outbreak response
article.articleSummary: As of June 16, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has resulted in 837 confirmed cases and 196 deaths, with a case fatality rate of approximately 24%. The outbreak, which began on May 15, is primarily concentrated in Ituri province, accounting for 95% of notifications. The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, highlighting the urgent need for international assistance. Community mistrust and violence against healthcare facilities are significant barriers to containment efforts. The outbreak has also crossed into Uganda, where 19 confirmed cases have been reported, including 14 imported from the DRC. The International Federation of the Red Cross warns that the outbreak may last up to a year and has not yet peaked, necessitating enhanced cross-border surveillance and community engagement. Testing capacity has been expanded to six sites in the DRC and four in Uganda, but challenges remain in addressing community fears and ensuring safe burial practices.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Democratic Republic of the Congo: International response intensifies amid worsening outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of June 17, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has resulted in 837 confirmed cases and 196 deaths since its declaration on May 15. The provinces of Ituri and North Kivu are the most affected, with ongoing conflict and community distrust complicating response efforts. In the last 24 hours, 29 new infections were reported, and only 12% of suspected contacts have been traced. The Africa CDC warns that this outbreak could surpass the severity of the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic. The G7 has called for coordinated international action, with the African Union pledging approximately $910 million for containment efforts. Children, particularly those aged 14 and under, are disproportionately affected, facing a fatality rate more than double that of older age groups. Misinformation and reliance on traditional healers further hinder effective treatment and containment. The outbreak is exacerbated by a lack of basic medical supplies and a significant humanitarian crisis affecting about 15 million people in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：感染者拡大中に国際的対応が強化

triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最優先感染症。837確認例、196死亡、致死率23.4%。北キブ州・イトゥリ州が主要流行地。過去24時間で29新規感染。接触者追跡率わずか12%で、地域紛争・医療不信が対応を著しく阻害。G7およびアフリカ連合が国際的対応を強化。西アフリカ流行（2014-2016）超過の可能性が指摘されている。フルRRA実施必須。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah in India: Kerala intensifies efforts to manage viral outbreaks
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, a critically ill patient remains on ventilator support due to the Nipah virus, with health authorities monitoring 103 individuals, including six under observation. Currently, no new Nipah cases have been reported, although one positive case was identified from 38 tested samples. The confirmed patient is in grave condition, prompting intensified containment efforts in high-risk areas like Palakkad and Malappuram. The state is also facing a significant Shigella outbreak, reporting 146 cases and five deaths this year. A high-power committee has been established to address both outbreaks, emphasizing the need for continued public health measures. Two more contacts of a Nipah patient were discharged after testing negative, while one new individual was admitted with Nipah-like symptoms, raising the total to nine admissions, with four discharged. The Health Minister has expressed confidence in preventing Nipah spread in 2026, highlighting ongoing management and proactive oversight.

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in India: Kerala intensifies efforts amid rising case counts
article.articleSummary: As of June 16, 2026, Kerala is experiencing a malaria outbreak with 349 reported cases, including three locally transmitted infections primarily affecting migrant workers from Madhya Pradesh. Health authorities are ramping up blood testing and vector control measures in response to the outbreak, particularly in Kozhikode, where a 63-year-old man was hospitalized. In Delhi, 42 malaria cases have been reported this year, a decrease from 70 in 2025, alongside 162 dengue and 9 chikungunya cases. The West Zone remains the most affected area, prompting ongoing vector-control initiatives, including house visits and legal actions against non-compliance. A high-powered committee has been established in Kerala to coordinate health strategies focusing on preventive actions against rising infectious diseases. As the monsoon season progresses, authorities are conducting extensive inspections, with over 1.7 crore households checked since January, resulting in thousands of legal notices and prosecutions to combat vector-borne diseases.

triage.notes: 記事サマリーはマラリアの発生を主題としているが、ソースURLはデング熱に関する記事を指しており、不一致がある。ただしサマリーの内容に基づけば、ケーラ州での349例のマラリア集団発生、デリー市での42例が報告されている。季節性（モンスーン時期の媒介蚊増加）と労働人口の移動（マディヤプラデーシュ州からの労働者）が流行しやすさを高めている。当局による積極的な対応措置（血液検査、蚊対策、委員会設置）から管理可能性の課題が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Shigellosis in India: Health authorities enhance response to ongoing outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of June 16, 2026, Kerala has reported 155 confirmed cases of Shigellosis, with a notable increase in June contributing 77 cases and 5 deaths. Health authorities are intensifying surveillance and public health measures, focusing on hygiene and access to safe drinking water. A high-power committee has been established to coordinate the response, while the Food Safety Department conducts inspections of bottled-water outlets to prevent contamination. New cases continue to emerge from various districts, including Idukki, where two students aged 4 and 9 tested positive. Daily hospital visits for fever exceed 13,000 statewide, prompting urgent action to address the outbreak and prevent further transmission. The fatalities occurred in Malappuram, Kozhikode, and Thrissur districts, attributed to disruptions in pre-monsoon sanitation drives and intensified surveillance efforts.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in India: Kerala faces critical outbreak during monsoon season
article.articleSummary: As of June 17, 2026, Kerala is grappling with a severe dengue outbreak, reporting 924 confirmed cases and three fatalities in the first half of the year. The overall fever situation is alarming, with daily cases surpassing 13,000 across various districts, including Thiruvananthapuram and Malappuram, which has reported the highest fever load. Surveillance for dengue and other febrile illnesses is ongoing as the monsoon season exacerbates the spread of these diseases.

article.articleHeadline: Malaria Falciparum in Vietnam: Imported cases raise alarm for health authorities
article.articleSummary: Vietnam is facing a concerning uptick in imported cases of malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum, particularly among individuals returning from Africa. Recent reports detail three severe cases, including two men aged 36 and 45, who developed critical symptoms after traveling to Congo and Angola. Both patients were hospitalized with high fevers and fatigue, confirmed through blood tests. Health officials emphasize the necessity for immediate medical attention for returning travelers and advocate for preventive measures such as the use of bed nets and chemoprophylaxis. Additionally, two more cases were diagnosed at Hanoi's National Central Hospital for Tropical Diseases, underscoring the urgent need for heightened awareness and proactive health measures to mitigate malaria risks among travelers. Authorities are urging anyone returning from malaria-endemic regions with acute fever to seek prompt medical care, aligning with WHO and national warnings about the escalating threat of imported malaria and the challenges it poses to Vietnam's 2030 elimination goals.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのマラリア・ファルシパルム：輸入例が保健当局に警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、またWPRO基準3項目以上該当（異常性、重症度、流行リスク）。アフリカからの輸入症例が複数確認され、公衆衛生当局および国際機関の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 複数の重症輸入症例（3例以上、うち2例は重症化）が確認され、ハノイの熱帯病専門医療機関で診断。アフリカ（コンゴ・アンゴラ）からの渡航者による輸入が主たるメカニズム。WHO警告およびベトナム2030年マラリア排除目標との関連性あり。ベクター対策（蚊帳）と化学予防が推奨されており、渡航者への啓発が強化されている。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah in India: Monitoring and response strategies in Kerala
article.articleSummary: As of June 17, 2026, Kerala is managing an active Nipah case involving a 43-year-old man from Kozhikode, who is currently on ventilator support. Intensive contact tracing has not identified any new infections. The region's monsoon season heightens risks due to ecological factors associated with fruit bat habitats, the virus's natural hosts. Kerala has experienced multiple Nipah outbreaks since 2018, with significant incidents resulting in 17 deaths and 23 cases in 2018 alone. Recent outbreaks were reported in 2019, 2021, and 2023-2025, with West Bengal confirming two cases among healthcare workers in January 2026, which were successfully contained. The WHO classifies Nipah as a high-priority pathogen due to its potential lethality. In response, Kerala's health authorities are implementing a One Health approach, enhancing rapid response protocols, and addressing concurrent health challenges such as Shigella and malaria. A high-level committee has been established to develop a comprehensive epidemic control plan, emphasizing the importance of vigilant public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: インドのニパウイルス：ケーラタ州の監視および対応戦略
triage.triage_reason: Nipahは高致死率の高優先度病原体であり、ケーラタ州での現在のアクティブケース（人工呼吸器使用）、歴史的な複数の集団発生（2018年17死亡）、国際的拡大の可能性（西ベンガル州での最近の発生、モンスーン季節の生態学的リスク）により、IHR基準3つおよびスクリーニング基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは現在の症例（43歳男性、Kozhikode在住、人工呼吸器使用中）と歴史的背景を明記。ケーラタ州での複数発生（2018年、2019年、2021年、2023-2025年）と西ベンガル州での最近の発生（2026年1月、医療労働者2名、確認・制御）を記載。モンスーン季節の生態学的リスク、フルーツコウモリの自然宿主としての役割が指摘されている。WHO高優先度病原体分類。One Health アプローチの実装、高度委員会の設立を含む対応措置が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Shigellosis in India: Health officials enhance measures amid rising infections
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, India, Shigellosis has affected 146 individuals over the past six months, resulting in five fatalities. The month of June alone recorded 71 new cases, prompting health authorities to issue a high alert. The Kozhikode district is the most impacted, with 74 cases, while Malappuram and Thiruvananthapuram each report 25 cases. Symptoms include severe diarrhea, abdominal cramps, and dehydration, which can escalate quickly after exposure to the Shigella bacteria. The disease spreads primarily through contaminated water and food, worsened by inadequate sanitation and crowded living conditions. In response, health officials are intensifying surveillance and public health initiatives, urging the community to adopt stringent hygiene practices, such as boiling water and proper food handling. Treatment typically involves rehydration, and antibiotics may be necessary for severe cases, although rising antibiotic resistance complicates treatment efforts. The outbreak underscores the urgent need for effective containment strategies to safeguard vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: インドの赤痢症：感染増加に伴い保健当局が対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：146例5死亡、異常：6ヶ月間の持続的発生、国際拡大リスク：水媒介感染症の流行），WPRO基準4つ該当（異常，重症度，長期曝露，流行しやすさ）。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ケーラ州を中心とした赤痢症の集中型流行。6ヶ月間で146例，5死亡，6月単月で71例と急増。コジコード地区が最も影響大（74例）。水媒介感染症であり，衛生環境不備と過密居住が拡大要因。抗生物質耐性の上昇が治療を複雑化。保健当局による高度警戒体制が敷かれている。

triage.headline_ja: インドのチクングニア：モンスーン季節中の媒介生物制御対策の強化
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア患者数は前年同期比で減少しており、重症度や国際的拡大の懸念は明らかではない。ただしデング熱を含む媒介蚊疾患の監視体制が活動中であり、モンスーン季節の季節的リスク増加に対する公衆衛生対応の進行中のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: チクングニア患者数は9例（前年同期14例より減少）、デング熱162例、マラリア42例。MCD主導の媒介蚊制御対策が積極的に進行中（83万戸以上を検査、幼虫検出4028件）。モンスーン季節に向けた季節的リスク増加があり、継続的な監視の対象。死亡例や重症者の報告はなく、国家対応は適切に機能している印象。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus Syndrome in Thailand: Severe cases and regional outbreaks reported
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus D68 has led to severe cases in Thailand, including a critical condition in a young girl who developed acute flaccid paralysis and is currently in the ICU. This year, Thailand has recorded five severe enterovirus infections, with three cases of D68 and one each of Coxsackie A4 and A16, resulting in one death. Surveillance indicates that Coxsackie A6 is the most prevalent strain, followed by Coxsackie A4, EV-D68, and Coxsackie A10. In week 23, there were 5,824 visits for enterovirus-related symptoms, reflecting increased activity. Neighboring countries, including Vietnam and China, are also facing rising enterovirus cases, with Vietnam reporting over 34,400 cases and China exceeding 280,000. There is currently no vaccine or antiviral treatment available, highlighting the importance of preventive measures such as hand hygiene and monitoring in schools and childcare facilities. Parents are urged to seek medical attention for severe symptoms like drowsiness or limb weakness.

triage.headline_ja: タイでのエンテロウイルス症候群：重症例と地域的な流行が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準で複数項目該当。重症例（急性弛緩性麻痺、死亡例）と地域流行が確認され、周辺国への拡大も報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはタイでの急性弛緩性麻痺を含む重症エンテロウイルスD68感染、複数の死亡例、および5,824件の週間受診報告を記載。ベトナムと中国での広範な流行も言及されており、地域全体の流行状況を示唆している。ワクチンと抗ウイルス薬が利用できない点も公衆衛生上の懸念である。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus Syndrome in China: Severe infections and regional outbreaks reported
article.articleSummary: In 2023, Enterovirus D68 has raised significant health concerns in China, with over 280,000 reported cases and a marked increase in severe infections. A notable incident involved a 5-year-old girl in northern Taiwan who developed acute flaccid paralysis and was admitted to the ICU, underscoring the outbreak's severity. The Taiwan CDC confirmed five severe enterovirus infections this year, including three cases of D68, one Coxsackie A4, and one Coxsackie A16, with one death recorded. Surveillance data from week 23 indicated 5,824 visits related to enterovirus infections, reflecting a 2.4% increase. The predominant circulating strains include Coxsackie A6, A4, EV-D68, and A10. Neighboring countries such as Vietnam, Thailand, South Korea, Japan, and Hong Kong are also experiencing heightened enterovirus activity, with Vietnam reporting over 34,400 cases. Public health measures emphasize hygiene practices, monitoring in schools and childcare facilities, and encouraging prompt medical attention for severe symptoms, particularly in children under five.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のエンテロウイルス症候群：重症感染と地域的流行の報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での報告、多数の重症例・死亡例、ヒト-ヒト感染の流行性があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは中国での28万例超、台湾での5重症例（1死亡）を報告。ベトナムでの3万4千例超を含むアジア太平洋地域での複数国流行。特に5歳以下の小児における急性弛緩性麻痺など重症症例が懸念される。対象国リストでは China、Thailand、Vietnam を verified_locations に含めた。台湾は対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus Syndrome in Vietnam: Rising cases and severe infections reported
article.articleSummary: Vietnam is experiencing a notable increase in Enterovirus infections, particularly Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68), raising significant public health concerns. Recent data indicates that in week 23, there were 5,824 medical visits related to enterovirus infections, marking a 2.4% increase. The most prevalent strain identified is Coxsackie A6, followed by Coxsackie A4, EV-D68, and Coxsackie A10. A severe case involving a young girl from northern Vietnam, who developed acute flaccid paralysis and is currently in the ICU, underscores the severity of the situation. Health authorities are urging the public to adhere to preventive measures such as hand hygiene and cough etiquette, especially in schools and childcare facilities, as there are no available vaccines or antiviral treatments. Children under five exhibiting symptoms like lethargy, weakness, or respiratory distress are advised to seek prompt medical attention. The situation is compounded by regional outbreaks in neighboring countries, including Taiwan, where severe cases have also been reported.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのエンテロウイルス症候群：感染例の増加と重篤な感染が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当し、重篤症例（急性弛緩性麻痺）、地域的流行、医療システムへの負荷が明らかであるため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: EV-D68による急性弛緩性麻痺（AFP）症例の報告は特に懸念される。週23で医療受診5,824件（前週比2.4%増）と増加傾向が明らかで、ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬がない状況下での流行拡大。隣国台湾でも重篤症例が確認されており、地域的に流行が波及している可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Diphtheria in Brazil: Vaccination efforts critical to control recent outbreaks
article.articleSummary: In the first 21 weeks of 2026, Brazil reported 163 confirmed diphtheria cases, contributing to a total of 163 cases across the Americas, with 5 fatalities. This represents a significant increase compared to 2025, with Brazil, Haiti, and Peru being the most affected countries. Notably, over half of the cases involved individuals who were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Diphtheria vaccination coverage (DTP3) has declined from 88% in 2023 to 87% in 2024, falling short of the 95% target, with many countries reporting coverage below 80%. The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) is urging countries to enhance routine immunization, implement catch-up vaccination programs, and improve surveillance and laboratory confirmation to address this public health concern. Immediate action is needed to prevent further cases and outbreaks, with a focus on reaching unvaccinated populations and ensuring adequate diphtheria antitoxin supplies.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのジフテリア：最近のアウトブレイクを制御するための予防接種の取り組みが重要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（163例、5死亡）、異常性（2025年比で大幅増加）、国際的拡大リスク（アメリカ地域全体で163例）の3つが該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例あり）、流行しやすさ（ワクチン未接種者が多数）、管理可能性（PAHOの国際的呼びかけ）が該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではブラジルが163例中の主要な発生国として述べられており、ハイチとペルーも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ。PAHOによる地域レベルの公衆衛生警告であり、ワクチン接種率低下（95%目標に対し87-88%）が根本原因とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Indonesia: Current statistics and prevention efforts highlighted
article.articleSummary: As of April 14, 2026, Indonesia has reported 30,465 dengue cases and 79 fatalities, resulting in a case fatality rate of 0.3%. The incidence rate stands at 10.6 per 100,000 population, with 10,138 cases of dengue fever, 19,877 of dengue hemorrhagic fever, and 450 of dengue shock syndrome across 401 districts in 29 provinces. Deaths have been recorded in 58 districts across 20 provinces. The World Dengue Day emphasizes the urgent need for vector control of Aedes aegypti and early detection to mitigate the disease's impact. Indonesia's prevention strategies align with the WHO Global Vector Control Response 2017–2030, focusing on effective vector management and early clinical intervention. Additionally, dengue fever is spreading to other popular travel destinations, including the Maldives, Sri Lanka, and Thailand, raising health concerns for travelers. Protective measures such as using repellents, wearing long light-colored clothing, and ensuring well-protected sleeping areas are recommended to reduce the risk of infection.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのデング熱：現在の統計と予防活動が強調されている
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおいて30,465件のデング熱症例と79人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常・予想外」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当し、シグナルとしてピックアップすべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではインドネシアを主要な発生地として報告しており、2026年4月14日時点で30,465例の症例と79人の死亡が確認されている。同時にモルディブ、スリランカ、タイへの地域的な拡大も記載されているが、これらの国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。世界デング熱デーの言及から国際的な関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Vietnam: Year-round transmission challenges public health efforts
article.articleSummary: Vietnam has reported over 50,000 dengue cases and 5 deaths from January to June 2026, marking a significant public health concern. Ho Chi Minh City alone has recorded 18,136 cases and 4 fatalities across its 168 wards. The epidemiology of dengue is evolving, with year-round transmission becoming increasingly common, particularly during the rainy season. Adults aged 11–30 are now more frequently affected. All four dengue serotypes are circulating, with DEN-1 and DEN-2 being the most prevalent, raising the risk of severe outcomes from secondary infections. Factors such as climate variability, urbanization, and population movement contribute to this trend. Public health officials stress the importance of vigilance and prompt treatment to prevent severe complications, including shock and organ failure. The Qdenga vaccine, approved for individuals aged 4 and older, has shown to significantly reduce lab-confirmed dengue cases and hospitalizations, highlighting the need for effective vector control and early medical intervention.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのデング熱：通年感染による公衆衛生対策の課題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な疫学パターン、国際的拡大リスク）。2026年上半期で50,000例超・5死亡、全4血清型が循環し、年通し感染が常態化する異常な疫学状況を呈している。フルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年上半期のベトナムデング熱流行に焦点を当てている。ホーチミン市での高い病例数（18,136例）、全血清型の同時循環、年通しの伝播パターン、11-30歳への年齢層の拡大といった複数の異常な疫学的特徴が認識されている。Qdenga予防接種の承認言及から、ベトナムは対策実施段階にあるが、ベクター制御と監視強化の必要性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza in Brazil: Vaccination efforts and fatalities reported in Campinas
article.articleSummary: As of June 16, 2026, Campinas, Brazil, has confirmed three additional deaths from influenza-associated Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI), bringing the total fatalities for the year to 13, alongside 169 reported cases. The deceased, aged 47, 73, and 69, all had comorbidities and were unvaccinated. The city's vaccination program, which includes protection against Influenza A (H1N1, H3N2) and B, has administered 276,438 doses, achieving 53.5% coverage among the elderly, 39.29% among children aged 6 months to 5 years, and 59.95% among pregnant women. Vaccination is available year-round at 69 health centers and the Divino Salvador Church, with no appointment necessary. Preventive measures recommended include frequent handwashing, maintaining well-ventilated spaces, staying hydrated, eating a healthy diet, and wearing masks when symptomatic. In 2025, Campinas reported 561 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) and 69 deaths, with a significant number of unvaccinated individuals.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのインフルエンザ：ワクチン接種の取り組みと死亡者数の報告（カンピナス）

triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの既知パターンであり、ワクチン接種プログラムが展開されている。死亡者の大多数が未接種かつ基礎疾患を有しており、予防可能な死亡と考えられる。現時点では新規病原体や異常な臨床像の報告はなく、国際的脅威度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Foot And Mouth Disease in Vietnam: Market closures and emergency responses intensify
article.articleSummary: As of June 16, 2026, Vietnam is facing significant challenges due to an outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) linked to the SAT1 serotype virus. On June 11, operations at Chợ bò Nghiên Loan, a major livestock market in Northern Vietnam, were suspended after testing revealed that 8 out of 10 buffalo samples were positive for the FMD virus, with serotypes A and O identified. This closure impacts local farmers financially, prompting calls for debt relief. In response, authorities are implementing disinfection, vaccination, and a mandatory 21-day surveillance period. Concurrently, Tuyên Quang Province is executing an emergency response plan focusing on early detection and containment of the SAT1 strain, which poses risks to cattle, buffalo, pigs, and goats. The strategy includes immediate vaccination, strict border controls, and public education on safe farming practices. The situation remains critical as efforts to control the outbreak intensify.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおける口蹄疫：市場閉鎖と緊急対応が強化される
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）の多地域での発生、家畜への重大な経済的影響、複数血清型（SAT1、A、O）の同時流行、および緊急対応体制の発動により、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当。IHR基準も異常性と国際拡大リスクで複数該当の可能性がある。
triage.notes: SAT1、A、Oの複数血清型が同時に検出される極めて異例の状況。複数の北部州（Tuyên Quang、Yên Bái、Lào Cai、Thái Nguyên、Hà Tĩnh）での同時発生が確認されている。主要な家畜市場の閉鎖、強制ワクチン接種、国境管理強化等の政府の対応体制が整備されている。東南アジア地域への越境リスクも存在。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in Indonesia: Community efforts enhance detection and treatment access
article.articleSummary: In Pekalongan Regency, Central Java, approximately 680 confirmed tuberculosis (TB) cases have prompted local authorities to intensify detection and prevention strategies. The Pekalongan Regency Government, in collaboration with the police, is implementing enhanced contact tracing measures targeting households with suspected TB cases. This initiative focuses on screening all household members of diagnosed patients to curb transmission risks. The government ensures free TB treatment through local health centers, making care accessible to affected individuals. Additionally, efforts are underway to increase BCG vaccination coverage and improve living conditions to further mitigate the spread of the disease. The proactive approach emphasizes community involvement and comprehensive management of TB, addressing both diagnosed patients and their close contacts.

Preventive measures are being emphasized, including the use of repellents, wearing protective clothing, and community engagement to reduce mosquito breeding sites. The World Health Organization has noted a global increase in dengue cases, with Vietnam being a key area of concern.

article.articleHeadline: Typhoid in India: Monsoon exacerbates waterborne disease outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Kerala is currently facing a health crisis with 11,534 individuals receiving treatment for fever-related illnesses, including typhoid. The district of Malappuram reports the highest number of cases at 2,470, followed by Kozhikode with 1,142 and Idukki with 298. In addition to typhoid, the region has seen 3,366 dengue cases this month and 107 confirmed cases of elephantiasis, with fatalities linked to these diseases. Meanwhile, in Ahmedabad, the Municipal Corporation reported 506 cases of waterborne diseases in the first 14 days of June, including 88 cases of typhoid. The onset of the monsoon season has raised concerns about water quality, with 30 water samples deemed unfit for consumption. Authorities are actively monitoring water safety and implementing chlorination measures to prevent further transmission. The situation highlights the urgent need for public health interventions to address the ongoing outbreak and mitigate the risks associated with contaminated water supplies.

triage.headline_ja: インドのチフス：モンスーンが水系伝染病の流行を悪化させている

triage.notes: ケーラ州とグジャラート州の両地域で水系伝染病の同時多発が確認。ケーラ州では11,534人が発熱関連疾患で治療中（チフス、デング熱3,366例、象皮病107例）、死亡事例あり。グジャラート州アーメダバードでは6月14日間で506件の水系伝染病事例（チフス88例）。モンスーン季節による水質悪化が主因と指摘されており、環境・ベクター・人間への影響が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Varicella in India: Health system under strain from multiple infectious diseases
article.articleSummary: As of June 16, 2026, Kerala is grappling with a significant health crisis, reporting a total of 11,534 individuals undergoing treatment for various fever-related illnesses. Among these, chickenpox has seen 1,111 cases this month alone. The state is also contending with outbreaks of polio, dengue, and Shigella, with polio cases reaching 107 and resulting in two fatalities. Dengue fever has affected 3,366 people, leading to three deaths, with new cases continuing to emerge. The highest concentration of fever patients is in Malappuram (2,470 cases) and Kozhikode (1,142 cases), while Idukki has reported 298 cases. A tragic incident in Wayanad involved the death of a 10-year-old due to complications from fever. The ongoing outbreaks are exacerbated by adverse weather conditions, underscoring the urgent need for improved surveillance and public health interventions to manage these concurrent health threats.

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever in Philippines: Local industry faces challenges amid ongoing outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of June 16, 2026, Nueva Vizcaya has reported 23 new cases of African swine fever (ASF) across the municipalities of Kasibu, Bayombong, and Villaverde, indicating a slight decrease from 25 cases last year. The local swine industry remains under significant threat, prompting the Department of Agriculture to allocate 10 million pesos to each affected municipality as part of the Swine Repopulation Project. Additionally, 300,000 pesos has been earmarked for animal health services, alongside the distribution of 1,000 rabies vaccine vials for pets and 40 cattle to tobacco farmers through a 2 million-peso initiative. Meanwhile, ASF outbreaks are also increasing in South Korea, highlighting the regional challenges in managing the disease. In Taiwan, New Taipei City has initiated a comprehensive tabletop exercise to enhance surveillance and response strategies for ASF and foot-and-mouth disease, emphasizing the need for rapid identification and containment of outbreaks.

article.articleHeadline: Typhoid in Thailand: Contaminated meals lead to widespread illness among children
article.articleSummary: In Yasothon Province, Thailand, a contaminated school lunch on June 9, 2026, resulted in 267 cases of illness among kindergarten students, primarily aged 3 to 5 years. Symptoms included stomach cramps, vomiting, diarrhea, and high fever, with 129 individuals requiring referral to Yasothon Hospital and 55 hospitalized. Investigations revealed microbiological contamination in the kitchen, with Salmonella spp., Aeromonas spp., and pathogenic strains of Escherichia coli identified as the culprits. In response, health authorities mandated thorough cleaning of the kitchen, infrastructure repairs, and the installation of insect screens. New protocols require meals to be freshly prepared within three hours of service. Long-term improvements to school kitchen facilities are planned to comply with health department standards.

triage.headline_ja: タイにおけるチフス：汚染された食事が子どもたちの広範な疾患をもたらす

triage.notes: 記事はYasothon Provinceの学校給食由来の大規模食中毒事案。病原体はSalmonella、Aeromonas、病原性E. coliで、チフスではなく食中毒と判定される。ただし疾患分類がTyphoidとされているため、タイアジング対象として扱う。対象国リストにThailandが含まれており、verified_locationsに該当。当局による衛生改善対応が既に実施されているため、国内管理能力は有。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza in India: Kerala faces high fever cases amid multiple illnesses
article.articleSummary: Kerala is experiencing a significant health challenge with daily fever cases surpassing 13,000. The districts of Thiruvananthapuram, Palakkad, Ernakulam, Thrissur, and Kozhikode are reporting over 1,000 fever patients each day, with Malappuram district leading with 2,198 cases. On June 17, 2026, a total of 13,196 individuals sought treatment for fever. The state is also monitoring dengue activity, with 252 patients exhibiting dengue-like symptoms and 52 confirmed cases. Additionally, 11 cases of eleppani and 5 malaria cases have been reported. Influenza is also present, with approximately 100 individuals seeking treatment for the virus. The situation highlights the ongoing spread of various communicable diseases in Kerala, necessitating continued public health surveillance and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: インドのインフルエンザ：ケーララ州が複数の病気の中で高熱患者に直面

triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ケーララ州を含むインド国内での多地域にわたる発熱患者の集中的発生が確認される。インフルエンザ約100件に加え、デング熱確認52件、マラリア5件、エレッパニ11件など複数の感染症が同時に流行している状況。1日13,000件以上の発熱患者という高い発症率は異常であり、公衆衛生当局の関心が高い。国際的拡大の直接的な記述はないため、「international_spread」はNo。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in Indonesia: Innovative education strategies to enhance TB awareness
article.articleSummary: In Papua, Indonesia, approximately 40,000 tuberculosis (TB) cases are reported, yet only 40% were detected in 2025, significantly below the 90% detection target. This leaves an estimated 24,000 undiagnosed cases that could potentially spread the disease. Factors such as poverty, difficult geography, and low health literacy contribute to the challenges in controlling TB, leading to care avoidance and treatment defaults. To address this, Ludenara and UNICEF Indonesia have introduced a TB card-game education program aimed at improving public understanding of TB symptoms, risk factors, and prevention methods. The game, designed for teams of 4-16 players, uses simple language and minimal text/icons to cater to varying literacy levels. A pilot program conducted from February to May 2025 in Bandung and Manokwari involved students, health workers, and TB cadres, resulting in increased knowledge about TB across all participant groups. This innovative approach highlights the importance of engaging educational strategies in combating TB in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアにおける結核：TB認識向上のための革新的教育戦略
triage.triage_reason: 結核は周知の疾患であり、記事の主眼は教育プログラムの紹介であるため。ただし、パプア州での未検出患者数が多く（24,000例）、地域的な検出率の低さが懸念事項として挙げられるため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 結核は既知感染症であり、新規発生・異常事象ではない。記事の主眼は教育戦略の紹介であり、感染症危機管理の観点からの긴급性は低い。ただし、24,000例の未検出患者が存在し、検出率が目標の90%に対して40%に留まっている点、地理的・社会経済的障壁により管理困難な状況が存在する点が懸念される。WPRO基準では複数項目で該当するが、社会的関心が教育プログラムであることから、即座のフルRRAは不要と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Indonesia: Regional outbreaks prompt urgent preventive measures
article.articleSummary: In June 2026, Indonesia faces significant dengue activity, mirroring trends seen in neighboring Singapore, which reported 119 cases in just one week. The rise in cases is attributed to warmer temperatures and rainfall, creating ideal conditions for Aedes mosquito breeding. Authorities in Indonesia are on high alert, implementing enhanced vector control measures in high-risk areas, including inspections and public awareness campaigns to encourage community participation in eliminating stagnant water. The situation is compounded by increased travel and mobility across Southeast Asia, necessitating cross-border vigilance. Health officials emphasize the importance of early detection and intervention, as even small clusters can lead to larger outbreaks. Symptoms to watch for include fever, headaches, and body aches. Ongoing efforts focus on sustained mosquito control and community cooperation to mitigate the impact of dengue in the region.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのデング熱：地域的な流行が緊急の予防措置を促す

triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシアでのデング熱地域流行を主題としており、Bluedot APIの発生地域（インドネシア）と一致。シンガポール（119例/週）の急増も言及されているが、サマリーの焦点はインドネシアの対応にあるため、verified_locationsはインドネシアのみとした。東南アジア地域全体での急速な蔓延傾向、気候要因による蚊の繁殖条件悪化、クラスターからの急速な拡大可能性が強調されており、国際的な感染症監視上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in Indonesia: Recent cases and misinformation challenge public health efforts
article.articleSummary: In early May 2026, a confirmed Hantavirus case was reported on the Dutch-flagged MV Hondius, marking an outbreak in Indonesia with at least three patients in Jakarta testing positive among six suspected cases. The Indonesian health ministry has documented 256 suspected Hantavirus cases and 23 confirmed infections of the Seoul virus-based Haemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS) from 2024 to 2026. These cases have emerged across various regions, including Jakarta, West Java, DI Yogyakarta, North Sulawesi, West Sumatra, and East Nusa Tenggara (NTT). Additionally, misinformation regarding Hantavirus victims has circulated on social media, with a viral video debunked as unrelated to the current outbreak, highlighting the challenges in public health communication.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのハンタウイルス感染：最近の事例と誤情報が公衆衛生の取組みに課題

triage.notes: オランダ船籍MV Hondiusでの発生を含む、2024-2026年の累積データであり、インドネシア国内での地理的拡大が著しい。ソウルウイルス由来のHFRS（出血熱腎症候群）であることが確認されている。公開されたAPIの発生地域はすべてインドネシア国内の複数州であり、検証済みである。記事が誤情報の流布を指摘していることから、社会的関心が高く、公式な公衆衛生対応が進行中と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Unknown Encephalitis in India: Rising cases and fatalities from amoebic infections
article.articleSummary: In 2026, Kerala reported 133 cases of Naegleria fowleri, a deadly amoeba causing Primary Amoebic Meningoencephalitis (PAM), resulting in 33 fatalities within the first five months. This amoeba, known for its high fatality rate of approximately 97%, has raised significant health concerns. Additionally, cases of Granulomatous Amoebic Encephalitis (GAE) caused by Acanthamoeba have also been documented. The situation highlights the urgent need for public health interventions and awareness to combat these life-threatening infections.

triage.headline_ja: インドの原因不明脳炎：アメーバ感染による患者数と死亡者数の増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4項目該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。高い致命率（97%）を伴う新興感染症として、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: Naegleria fowleriによる一次アメーバ性髄膜脳炎（PAM）の致命率97%は極めて高く、5ヶ月間で133例、33死亡という急増傾向は深刻。Acanthamoeba肉芽腫性アメーバ脳炎（GAE）の同時報告も環境媒介の懸念を示唆。地域検証：記事はケーララ州を明示し、インド国内の発生イベントとして確認。

article.articleHeadline: Meningoencephalitis in India: Recent cases and fatalities highlight urgent health concerns
article.articleSummary: In 2026, India reported alarming cases of Primary Amoebic Meningoencephalitis (PAM) caused by Naegleria fowleri, with a staggering global fatality rate of approximately 97%. Specifically, Kerala has documented 133 positive cases and 33 deaths within the first five months of the year. The situation is compounded by the emergence of Granulomatous Amoebic Encephalitis (GAE) linked to Acanthamoeba, further stressing the need for public health interventions. The ongoing health crisis underscores the critical importance of awareness and preventive measures to combat these deadly infections.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当。高い致死率（97%）、2026年1月～5月に133例・33死亡、新興感染症の出現により、フルRRA対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Indonesia: Recent attack highlights ongoing vaccination challenges
article.articleSummary: On June 15, 2026, a rabies-suspected dog attacked attendees at a local celebration in Desa Tegal Badeng Timur, Jembrana, Bali, injuring three individuals, including two toddlers. The victims included a 47-year-old man and two young children, aged 4 and 5, with one child, Nara, not having received the anti-rabies vaccination (VAR). The dog, which later exhibited neurological symptoms and died the following day, had an unknown vaccination status, and its owner was reportedly ill. Authorities collected brain tissue for rabies confirmation and traced the victims to ensure they received the necessary vaccinations. This incident highlights the persistent risk of rabies in Bali, particularly from unvaccinated pets, and emphasizes the urgent need for vaccination outreach to prevent future attacks.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの狂犬病：最近の攻撃事件は継続的なワクチン接種の課題を浮き彫りにしている

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Philippines: Weather patterns influence disease management strategies
article.articleSummary: As of June 17, 2026, the Philippines is bracing for an increase in dengue cases attributed to the El Niño phenomenon, which is expected to elevate temperatures and enhance the breeding conditions for Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The Ministry of Health has activated a comprehensive response plan aimed at mitigating the public health impact, particularly in regions with historically high incidence rates. Key measures include targeted elimination of mosquito breeding sites, home fumigation, and ensuring access to clean water. Health authorities are emphasizing vector control and community engagement to prevent transmission, with a focus on environmental management to shorten the duration of outbreaks. This proactive approach underscores the significant influence of weather patterns on disease dynamics and public health strategies.

triage.notes: El Niño現象によるエジプトシマカの繁殖環境拡大が原因とされており、フィリピン保健省が包括的対応計画を発動している。ベクター制御と環境管理が重点対策として実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Foot And Mouth Disease in Vietnam: Containment efforts underway after recent outbreak
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease, serotype A, has reemerged in Vietnam after an eight-year absence, with the first detection occurring in Nghiên Loan commune, Thai Nguyen Province, at the region's largest cattle market. Following the outbreak, authorities implemented immediate containment measures, including market suspension and daily disinfection efforts involving over 50 local volunteers using 400 kg of lime and 700 liters of disinfectant. Traders are now required to report sick animals and cooperate with authorities, while police and trade agencies have intensified checks on transport and slaughter activities. As of June 13, no new infections have been reported in Nghiên Loan, and cattle at Giàng Tiến Cooperative are stabilizing. To prevent further spread, authorities have requested 15,000 vaccine doses and additional disinfectant for ring vaccination around the outbreak area.

triage.notes: 口蹄疫は家畜伝播感染症であり、畜産経済に深刻な影響を及ぼす。8年ぶりの再出現は地域的に重大なシグナル。複数の省（ハイフォン市、フンイエン省、トゥイェンクアン省など）での検出報告があり、感染拡大のリスクが高い。ワクチン調達・リング予防接種など管理介入が講じられている点は評価されるが、地域内での持続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in India: Intensive efforts to combat tuberculosis in vulnerable populations
article.articleSummary: In the first five months of 2026, Jammu and Kashmir reported 4,472 tuberculosis cases, achieving approximately 40% of its annual target. This surge is attributed to the intensified Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan, particularly during Phase-II of the 100-Day TB Mukt Bharat Campaign, where the region secured the second rank nationwide. Over 245,000 individuals were screened, with 70% receiving X-ray examinations and 90% of cases utilizing NAAT-based molecular testing. More than 2,100 TB patients benefited from Poshan Kits, and community support was bolstered with 13,100 Nikshay Mitras involved in patient care. The administration has focused on enhancing screening in high-risk areas, increasing TB Preventive Treatment coverage from 7% to 34%, and utilizing digital tools like the TB Mukt Bharat App and Khushi Chatbot to improve patient adherence and care delivery.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Indonesia: Cross-border concerns amid ongoing humanitarian crisis
article.articleSummary: As of June 17, 2026, an Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has exceeded 550 confirmed cases and over 100 deaths. The situation is exacerbated by armed insecurity, which obstructs international medical teams from accessing displacement camps, thereby hindering essential activities such as contact tracing, vaccination, and safe burials. Militant groups in North Kivu Province are complicating the humanitarian crisis, making it difficult to contain the outbreak. The World Health Organization has activated emergency protocols and is collaborating with local authorities to distribute vaccines and protective equipment. While there is significant international concern regarding the potential for cross-border transmission, current cases remain limited to North Kivu. Without timely treatment, Ebola's fatality rate can surpass 50%. Humanitarian organizations on the ground are warning that the capacity to respond effectively is severely compromised due to ongoing conflict and mass displacement.

article.articleHeadline: Vaccine-derived Poliomyelitis in India: Environmental surveillance reveals pockets of under-immunization
article.articleSummary: On June 9, 2026, Ghaziabad district in Uttar Pradesh reported the detection of vaccine-derived poliovirus type 1 (VDPV1) in sewage, indicating the presence of the virus in the environment rather than a wild polio outbreak. India has maintained its polio-free status since January 13, 2011, and was certified polio-free by the WHO Southeast Asia region in 2014. The emergence of VDPV is linked to the circulation of the weakened live oral vaccine virus in communities with low immunization rates, where it can mutate and regain virulence. Previous detections of VDPV occurred in Kolkata in April 2022 and in Meghalaya’s West Garo Hills in 2024. The current response includes intensified vaccination efforts targeting under-immunized children, verification of vaccination records, repeat sewage sampling, and enhanced acute flaccid paralysis surveillance, particularly in urban migrant and informal settlements identified as coverage gaps.

article.articleSummary: As of June 17, 2026, Nakhon Ratchasima Province in Thailand is addressing a rabies concern following a dog-bite incident in Nong Bu Sala, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima District. Community leaders are actively involved in disseminating public education on rabies prevention. Residents who experience bites, scratches, or exposure to dog saliva are advised to wash the affected area with soap and water immediately and seek medical evaluation for potential post-exposure vaccination. The provincial public health office, along with relevant agencies, is committed to containment measures and continuous monitoring in the affected area.

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis B in Brazil: Deforestation linked to hepatitis B transmission risks
article.articleSummary: As of June 16, 2026, hepatitis B has been identified in Amazonian monkeys in Brazil, with a notable 34.7% positivity rate in Rondônia and Mato Grosso from samples of 88 primates across 28 species. In contrast, the remote Alto Rio Japurá region reported zero cases. A recent EcoHealth study revealed that the viral sequences found in these monkeys are molecularly identical to local human hepatitis B strains, indicating a potential reverse zoonotic transmission associated with deforestation and habitat fragmentation. Investigations are ongoing into transmission pathways, which may include exposure to improperly disposed domestic waste and untreated sewage near forest edges, as well as increased human-primate interactions due to tourism and illegal hunting. The ecological impact includes demographic declines in monkey populations and disruptions to their reproductive functions and seed dispersal. The study emphasizes the urgent need for enhanced conservation policies and improved sanitation measures to mitigate edge fragmentation and prevent future zoonotic spillovers.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのB型肝炎：森林破壊がB型肝炎伝播リスクと関連

triage.notes: 本イベントは野生動物（アマゾンのサル）でのB型肝炎検出が主題であり、人での感染事例は報告されていない。逆人畜共通感染の可能性が示唆されているが、現在のところ人への直接的な脅威の証拠は限定的。森林破壊と関連した環境衛生上の関心が高いが、人への公衆衛生影響の深刻度は不明。対象国リストにはBrazil（3469034）が含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Trichinellosis in Philippines: Enhanced surveillance and control measures implemented
article.articleSummary: Recent developments in the Philippines indicate a heightened focus on controlling trichinellosis following the detection of new cases. The Department of Health has reported an increase in human infections linked to contaminated pork products, prompting immediate action to strengthen surveillance and preventive measures. Authorities are conducting inspections and serological testing in areas with reported cases, particularly in regions known for home-made charcuterie production. The risk of infection remains significant as infected animals often show no visible symptoms, making it crucial for consumers to purchase pork from licensed vendors and ensure proper cooking temperatures. Ongoing investigations aim to trace the sources of contamination and prevent further outbreaks.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数基準に該当。フィリピンでの食品由来感染症として対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Infection in Brazil: Increased hospitalizations among young children reported
article.articleSummary: As of June 16, 2026, Acre has recorded 1,547 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI), marking a 36.4% increase from 2025. The capital, Rio Branco, reports the highest number of cases at 629, followed by Cruzeiro do Sul (236), Marechal Thaumaturgo (136), and Feijó (125). The co-circulation of Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), Rhinovirus, and Influenza A is contributing to increased hospitalizations, particularly for pneumonia and bronchiolitis. The most affected age groups include children aged 2-4 years (331 hospitalizations), 5-9 years (289), under 2 years (237), and individuals over 60 years (291). Vaccination rates for Influenza remain below 90% in priority groups, prompting health officials to call for enhanced vaccination efforts and monitoring of pediatric healthcare resources.

triage.notes: Acre州で2025年比36.4%増の1,547件のSARI症例が報告され、RSV・ライノウイルス・インフルエンザAの同時流行が幼児と高齢者に重症化をもたらしている。予防接種率がインフルエンザで90%未満であることが指摘されている。小児医療リソースの監視強化が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in Brazil: Intensive vector control efforts underway in Indigenous areas
article.articleSummary: Between June 8 and 12, vector-control initiatives were executed in the Bororó and Jaguapiru villages of the Dourados Indigenous Health District, targeting Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Inspectors evaluated 2,706 homes and treated over 600 water tanks, successfully eliminating 617 breeding sites. The ongoing surveillance has reported a total of 3,255 chikungunya notifications within the Indigenous Reserve, including 2,447 probable cases and 2,183 confirmed cases, alongside 10 fatalities. In Dourados city, the situation is similarly concerning, with 9,621 notifications recorded, comprising 5,109 probable and 4,693 confirmed cases. Hospitalizations related to chikungunya have reached 18 across various healthcare facilities. These efforts are part of a broader strategy to control the chikungunya outbreak and mitigate its impact on the affected communities.

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in Brazil: Recent cases highlight ongoing public health challenges
article.articleSummary: In 2026, the state of Rio de Janeiro reported eight malaria cases, all classified as imported or of unknown origin. Nationally, Brazil achieved its lowest malaria levels in 2025 since the late 1970s, with a 15% decrease in cases from 2024. Severe malaria cases were reduced by approximately 30%, and malaria-related deaths fell by 28%. In the Yanomami indigenous territory, malaria cases decreased by 22% compared to 2024, with deaths dropping significantly by 80%. The Health Ministry credits the decline in fatalities to the increased use of tafenoquine, including a pediatric formulation introduced in March 2026, particularly benefiting indigenous populations. Despite these improvements, malaria continues to pose a significant public health challenge in Brazil's tropical and subtropical regions, with ongoing efforts needed to combat transmission and improve health outcomes.

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Ghana: Urgent call for vaccination amid rising fatalities
article.articleSummary: In the first half of 2026, Ghana's Western Region reported three rabies-related deaths, with two occurring in Wassa East District and one in Jomoro Municipality. The Western Regional Veterinary Services Directorate emphasizes the preventable nature of rabies, urging dog owners to adhere to annual vaccination protocols at designated service centers. Compliance is being enforced through punitive measures linked to dog licensing. Despite the availability of vaccines, uptake remains a significant challenge. Dr. Simon Gbene, the Regional Director, highlights the critical need for immediate medical attention following dog bites, as the rabies virus can persist in the human body for up to two years. He advocates for local government support to subsidize vaccination costs, aiming to enhance coverage and ultimately reduce preventable fatalities. Globally, rabies claims approximately 70,000 children's lives annually due to dog bites and related complications, underscoring the urgency of addressing this public health issue.

article.articleHeadline: Leprosy in India: Renewed transmission and treatment efforts underway
article.articleSummary: Leprosy is resurging in Uttar Pradesh, India, with active infections found in 15-year-olds. In 2024-25, 1.42% of under-15s tested positive for Mycobacterium leprae, slightly decreasing to 1.39% in the first phase of 2025-26, indicating ongoing transmission risks. This year, there have been 1,353 new leprosy cases reported, with 201,202 patients treated and 1,671 individuals currently infected. Over 154 children are confirmed to harbor the bacteria. Surgical interventions are being utilized, with 359 surgeries conducted at King George’s Medical University and other hospitals in Barabanki and Ayodhya. The National Leprosy Eradication Programme is implementing new strategies to curb the spread of the disease. Early detection remains crucial, allowing for 100% treatment success. Maharashtra continues to report the highest burden of cases, followed by Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, underscoring persistent stigma and care gaps in the management of leprosy.

article.articleSummary: As of June 9, 2026, North Central Timor Regency in East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, has reported 1,401 cases of bites from rabies-transmitting animals (HPR). article.articleHeadline: Listeria in China: Health risks from street food desserts highlighted
article.articleSummary: On June 16, 2026, a child in Hubei Province was hospitalized in the ICU due to severe food poisoning linked to tiramisu purchased from a roadside stall. In Fuzhou, Fujian, mobile vendors sell tiramisu and other cold desserts near schools, raising significant health concerns. These items are often inadequately stored, with some kept at room temperature, which is particularly dangerous in hot weather. Dr. Gao Wenyu from Fujian Medical University warns that tiramisu, made with raw eggs, cream, and cheese, poses a risk for Listeria and other pathogens due to insufficient pasteurization. The toxins produced by these bacteria can lead to serious health complications, including toxic megacolon and multi-organ failure, necessitating ICU care or surgery. Symptoms such as severe diarrhea, dehydration, and abdominal pain require immediate medical attention. Parents are advised to avoid street food in summer and opt for refrigerated, licensed vendors, consuming such desserts promptly to minimize health risks.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のリステリア菌：屋台デザートからの健康リスク強調

triage.notes: 記事は中国（福建省福州および湖北省）でのリステリア菌関連の食品中毒事例を報告。ICU入院例、多臓器不全リスク、学校近くでの屋台販売による子どもへの曝露リスク、不十分な食品保管管理が懸念される。複数のWPRO基準に該当し、社会的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in Democratic Republic of the Congo: Severe cases highlight urgent need for prevention measures
article.articleSummary: Recent reports indicate a critical situation regarding malaria in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, particularly concerning Plasmodium falciparum, the most lethal malaria parasite. Two Vietnamese workers returning from Africa were diagnosed with severe malaria after experiencing high fevers and chills. One patient, H.V.T., developed a fever reaching 40°C within two weeks of returning from Congo, while M.T.H. had persistent fever for two months, peaking at 40.2°C shortly before hospitalization. Both were treated with intensive antimalarial therapy at the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases, leading to rapid recovery. This case emphasizes the importance of prompt medical evaluation for travelers returning from malaria-endemic regions and highlights the need for effective prevention strategies, including vector control and prophylactic measures for at-risk individuals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のマラリア：重症例が予防対策の緊急の必要性を浮き彫りにする
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのマラリア発生は既知の風土病であり、本事例はアフリカ帰還のベトナム人労働者への輸入感染である。地域的な新規フェーズや拡大の証拠は記事に明記されていない。
triage.notes: 記事主体はDRCでのマラリア発生とそれに伴うベトナムへの輸入症例である。DRCはマラリア風土病地域であり、本事例は既知リスクの範囲内。社会的・政治的関心の情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定。続報で国内伝播または事例集積の報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Brazil: Travel warnings issued as cases spread regionally
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is increasingly affecting Brazil, alongside other Latin American countries such as Mexico, Peru, and Colombia. The current situation is concerning, with significant case counts reported in popular travel destinations. The spread is attributed to mosquito transmission, with experts highlighting the need for caution among travelers. Protective measures are recommended, including the use of repellents containing DEET or Icaridin, wearing long light-colored clothing, and ensuring sleeping areas are well-protected from mosquitoes. The rise in cases in Brazil and neighboring regions underscores the importance of awareness and preventive strategies to mitigate health risks associated with dengue.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのデング熱：地域感染の拡大に伴い渡航警告が発令される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱の地域的拡大が報告され、渡航警告が発令されている。公衆衛生への影響が深刻で、国際的な渡航・貿易制限のリスクがあるため、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではブラジルを中心とした地域的なデング熱流行を述べており、メキシコ、ペルー、コロンビアなど他のラテンアメリカ諸国への言及があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはブラジルのみを記載。渡航警告発令、複数の予防措置の推奨、専門家による危機警告など、社会的・政治的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Thailand: Travel warnings issued amid rising health risks
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Thailand have increased significantly since 2025, particularly in tourist hotspots such as Phuket, Krabi, and Bangkok. The current situation reflects a broader trend of rising dengue cases across Southeast Asia, with Sri Lanka reporting tens of thousands of infections this year. The Maldives has also seen a notable increase, prompting health experts to issue travel warnings for popular destinations. Other regions, including Indonesia and parts of the Caribbean and Latin America, are experiencing similar outbreaks, with Brazil, Mexico, Peru, and Colombia among the affected countries. Health officials emphasize the importance of protective measures for travelers, including the use of mosquito repellents containing DEET or Icaridin, wearing long light-colored clothing, and ensuring sleeping areas are well-protected from mosquito access. The ongoing situation underscores the need for vigilance and preparedness against mosquito-borne diseases during travel.

triage.headline_ja: タイのデング熱：健康リスク上昇の中、渡航警告が発令
triage.triage_reason: タイでデング熱患者数が2025年以降大幅に増加しており、観光地での感染が報告されている。IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度・流行しやすさに該当し、渡航警告が発令されるなど社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではタイ、スリランカ、モルディブ、インドネシア、ブラジル、メキシコ、ペルー、コロンビアが言及されているが、検証対象国リストに含まれるのはタイのみ。2026年6月時点での配信であるため、2025年から継続している流行状況を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Myanmar: Health officials emphasize early treatment and prevention measures
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases have been reported in Mon State, Myanmar, particularly affecting children under 15. Health officials are advising parents against home treatment for fever, stressing the importance of early medical intervention to prevent severe complications. Currently, early rainy-season cases are approximately 5% of last year's figures, with one to two cases reported per ward and nearly 10 children in Mawlamyine receiving treatment, all in stable condition. Officials caution against complacency, as severe dengue can escalate to critical stages. The disease is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, which thrive in clean water, prompting ongoing prevention campaigns that include insecticide spraying and inspections of potential breeding sites. The State Health Department, operating under the military junta, is actively working to mitigate outbreaks during the rainy season, recalling that Mon State experienced around 1,000 dengue cases during the same period in 2025, with some cases reaching Stage 4.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマーのデング熱：保健当局が早期治療と予防対策を強調
triage.triage_reason: ミャンマーのモン州でデング熱が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準で「異常/予想外」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性があるが、現在の症例数は昨年同時期の5%程度で情報が限定的。続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はミャンマーで季節的に定期的に発生する疾患であり、本記事は予防的・啓発的性質が強い。現在の症例数は少数（約10名）で、昨年同時期比5%程度と低い水準。ただし雨季に向けての継続的な流行リスク（昨年は1,000件超）があるため、進展を監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria Falciparum in Democratic Republic of the Congo: Recent cases highlight ongoing health challenges
article.articleSummary: Two Vietnamese workers returning from Africa were diagnosed with malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum, the most virulent malaria parasite. Their cases were linked to their assignments in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Angola. Symptoms included high fever, severe chills, headaches, nausea, and dizziness, with one patient experiencing recurring febrile episodes during his time in Congo. After returning to Vietnam, fever recurred two weeks later, prompting admission to the National Institute of Tropical Diseases. Laboratory tests confirmed the Plasmodium falciparum infection, which can lead to severe complications and death if untreated. Both patients received intensive treatment with antimalarials, resulting in a positive response and resolution of fever. This situation underscores the importance of seeking medical care for fever after returning from malaria-endemic regions and highlights the need for effective prophylaxis for travelers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのマラリア・ファルシパルム：最近の症例が継続する健康上の課題を浮き彫りに
triage.triage_reason: 2名のベトナム帰国労働者のマラリア感染確認は異常・予想外な出来事だが、症例数が限定的で地域的な一過性発生の可能性が高い。IHR基準2つ以上の該当が認定されず、WPROスクリーニング基準の該当は複数だが社会的関心の程度が明らかでないため、経過観察対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは2名のベトナム労働者がコンゴ民主共和国およびアンゴラで感染したと述べられている。アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ含めるべきだが、ベトナムでの発症検出という点で国際スクリーニングの観点からは重要。IHR基準は3つ該当（serious_impact: 未治療時は重篤化・死亡リスク、unusual_unexpected: 来訪労働者による輸入症例、international_spread: ベトナムへの拡散を示唆）だが、症例数が限定的（2例）で流行拡大の兆候が報告されていないため、フルRRAへの昇格判定には保留判断とする。追加情報（ベトナム国内での2次感染有無、その他輸入症例）を待つ必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Lymphatic Filariasis in India: Rising cases amid monsoon-related health challenges
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, India, a total of 11,534 individuals are currently undergoing treatment for fever-related illnesses, with Malappuram reporting the highest number of cases at 2,470. The region is facing significant health challenges, including 107 confirmed cases of elephantiasis in June, alongside 82 suspected cases. Dengue fever remains a critical concern, with 3,366 reported infections this month, leading to 3 dengue-related deaths. Other illnesses such as influenza, cholera, typhoid, and amoebic meningitis are also prevalent. The monsoon season is exacerbating the situation, contributing to the spread of these diseases. Notable dengue hotspots include Kozhikode, Pathanamthitta, and Kollam, with multiple cases reported in other districts as well. The health authorities are on high alert as they manage these outbreaks and work to mitigate the impact of the ongoing monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: インドにおけるリンパ性フィラリア症：モンスーン関連の健康課題の中での増加症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・予想外性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（象皮病確認例107件、死亡例3件）、流行しやすさ（モンスーン時期の多くの病原体共流行）、管理可能性（複数疾患の同時流行で保健当局が警戒態勢）が該当。ケーララ州での複合感染症流行はシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケーララ州のリンパ性フィラリア症（象皮病）を主題としており、同時にデング熱、インフルエンザ、コレラ、チフス、アメーバ性髄膜炎などの複数疾患が流行中。モンスーン時期の複合感染症流行として管理可能性に懸念あり。死亡例（デング関連3件）および確認症例数（象皮病107件、デング3,366件）から重症度基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: West Nile in India: Multiple vector-borne diseases reported amid monsoon season
article.articleSummary: Kerala is currently facing a significant health crisis with 11,534 individuals undergoing treatment for various fever-related illnesses, including West Nile virus. The district of Malappuram has the highest number of cases at 2,470, followed by Kozhikode with 1,142 and Idukki with 298. Tragically, a 10-year-old has died from complications related to these illnesses. In addition to West Nile, the state is grappling with 3,366 dengue cases, which have resulted in three deaths this month, alongside nine influenza and two elephantiasis fatalities. The monsoon season is exacerbating the situation, with reported cases of elephantiasis totaling 107 in June alone. Other diseases such as cholera, typhoid, and amoebic meningitis/encephalitis are also present, highlighting the urgent need for public health interventions to control the spread of these vector-borne diseases.

triage.headline_ja: インドのウエストナイル：モンスーン季に多数のベクター媒介疾患が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。ウエストナイル含む複数の媒介昆虫病が同時発生し、死亡者を含む重症例が報告されており、早急なフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ケララ州でウエストナイルを含む複数のベクター媒介病が同時発生。11,534名が治療中、少なくとも5名の死亡報告あり。モンスーン季の環境が流行を悪化させている。デング熱3,366例も報告されており、公衆衛生上の重大な危機。記事ソースはケララ州の地方メディア（deshabhimani.com）。

triage.headline_ja: インドの原因不明脳炎：発熱関連疾患のケース数が増加
triage.triage_reason: インド（ケーラ州）で多数の発熱関連疾患の集団発生が報告されており、死亡例を含む重症例が確認されている。IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、スクリーニング基準でも重症度と流行しやすさが該当する。
triage.notes: ケーラ州で原因不明脳炎を含む複数の発熱関連疾患（デング熱、象皮症、インフルエンザ、コレラ、チフス、水痘、赤痢など）の同時発生が報告されている。11,534人の治療中患者、死亡例1件、モンスーン季による拡大のリスクが存在。複合的な病原体による公衆衛生上の脅威として評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera in India: Monsoon conditions exacerbate health challenges
article.articleSummary: Kerala is currently facing a significant health crisis with over 11,534 individuals undergoing treatment for various fever-related illnesses, including cholera, typhoid, and dengue. The district of Malappuram reports the highest number of cases at 2,470, followed by Kozhikode with 1,142 and Idukki with 298. Recent fatalities include a 10-year-old in Wayanad. The monsoon season has contributed to the spread of diseases, with 3,366 dengue cases reported this month alone, resulting in multiple deaths. Additionally, 107 cases of elephantiasis have been documented in June, alongside confirmed cases of Shigella and other infections. The situation remains critical as health authorities work to manage the outbreak amid challenging weather conditions.

triage.headline_ja: インドのコレラ：モンスーン条件が健康上の課題を悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が確認される。複数の死亡、11,534人の患者、ヒト-ヒト感染可能な複数疾患の同時流行がモンスーン期に発生している。
triage.notes: ケーララ州を中心とした複合的な流行：コレラ、チフス、デング熱、シゲラ症が同時に発生。モンスーン期による加速と複数死亡確認。国内の複数地区（マラプラム、コジコド、イドゥッキなど）での広範な拡大が確認される。

triage.headline_ja: インドのインフルエンザ：モンスーン季の現在の健康上の課題
triage.triage_reason: ケーララ州で複数の感染症（インフルエンザ、コレラ、腸チフス、デング熱、象皮病）による大規模な健康危機が発生しており、11,534人が治療を受け死亡者も報告されている。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響と異常性が認められ、スクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理能力の懸念がある。
triage.notes: ケーララ州で複数の病原体による同時流行が進行中。モンスーン季による環境条件が感染拡大を加速させている。死亡事例（デング熱3件、インフルエンザ9件、象皮病2件）と象皮病の急増（6月だけで107例）が報告されている。公衆衛生上の緊急対応が必要な状況と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Poliomyelitis in India: Current challenges amid rising fever cases
article.articleSummary: As of June 16, 2026, Kerala is facing significant health challenges with polio and dengue fever among the major threats. The state reports 11,534 individuals undergoing treatment for fever, with polio accounting for 107 cases in June, including 82 suspected cases and two confirmed deaths. Dengue fever has also escalated, with 3,366 cases and three fatalities reported, alongside 85 new cases on the latest day. Other diseases such as Shigella, with 135 confirmed cases this year, and chickenpox, with 1,111 cases this month, are contributing to the health crisis. The highest number of fever patients is in Malappuram (2,470) and Kozhikode (1,142), while Idukki has reported 298 cases. A fatality in a 10-year-old child from Wayanad highlights the urgent need for public health measures and surveillance to manage these outbreaks effectively.

triage.headline_ja: インドのポリオ: 発熱症例の増加の中での現在の課題
triage.triage_reason: ポリオは国際保健規則(IHR)上の指定疾患であり、確定症例2件と多数の疑似症例(107件)、および死亡例を含む深刻な公衆衛生影響がある。複数の基準を満たし、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ポリオは撲滅段階にある疾患であり、確定症例の報告は極めて重大。ケーララ州での同時多発的な発熱性疾患(ポリオ、デング熱、シゲラ、水痘)の流行は、公衆衛生体制の脆弱性を示唆する。死亡例(10歳児を含む)の報告は緊急対応の必要性を示唆。2026年6月という時間設定は架空である可能性があるが、情報はシグナルとして評価。

article.articleHeadline: Foot And Mouth Disease in China: Ongoing outbreaks in multiple provinces raise concerns
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is currently affecting seven provinces in China, with significant implications for livestock health and agricultural stability. Recent reports indicate that the disease is being closely monitored, with advanced surveillance measures being implemented to track and manage outbreaks. In response to the ongoing situation, New Taipei City has conducted a comprehensive tabletop exercise involving 105 participants to simulate various scenarios related to FMD and African swine fever (ASF). This exercise aims to enhance preparedness and response strategies, utilizing technologies such as AIoT for monitoring and GPS tracking to identify potential risk sources. The Animal Protection Office has emphasized the importance of timely reporting of suspected cases, imposing strict penalties for late notifications. The proactive measures taken in both China and Taiwan reflect the urgency of controlling FMD and preventing its spread, particularly in regions heavily reliant on pig farming.

triage.headline_ja: 中国での口蹄疫: 複数省での継続的な爆発が懸念を高める
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は経済的に重要な家畜疾病であり、中国の7つの州で発生している。国際的な家畜貿易への影響およびアジア地域全体への拡大リスクが懸念される。台湾など隣接地域での準備体制の強化が示唆される。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は動物疾病（影響カテゴリ: animals）であるが、農業経済への深刻な影響と、アジア地域の家畜貿易への波及リスクから、WPRO域内の公衆衛生上の重要性が高い。台湾での演習実施は地域的な関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis in India: Health officials warn of increased infection risk
article.articleSummary: In Ernakulam district, Kerala, the health department has reported a concerning rise in leptospirosis cases during the monsoon season, with 10 confirmed and 9 suspected cases recorded in just the first 13 days of June. The disease is transmitted through direct contact with contaminated soil and stagnant water, with the bacteria entering the body through cuts and abrasions. Health officials are urging the public to take preventive measures, such as wearing gloves and waterproof footwear when in muddy or waterlogged areas. Symptoms to watch for include severe fatigue, calf muscle pain, headache, fever, and back pain. Individuals experiencing these symptoms, especially those with known exposure to contaminated environments, are advised to seek medical attention promptly and avoid self-medication. The health department emphasizes the importance of vigilance and adherence to safety guidelines to mitigate the risk of infection during this high-risk period.

triage.headline_ja: インドのレプトスピラ症：保健当局が感染リスク増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: ケーラ州エルナクラム地区での確認症例・疑い症例の急増（6月初旬13日間で19例）、季節性の高リスク期間、公衆衛生上の懸念があり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節における環境条件（汚染土壌・停滞水）の悪化により、ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく環境経由の感染リスクが高い。ケーラ州エルナクラム地区での局所的な集積だが、季節性と環境条件から今後の拡大リスクがある。保健部門による積極的な情報発信と公衆衛生指導が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: E. coli in Thailand: Investigation reveals foodborne illness sources
article.articleSummary: A foodborne illness outbreak at Municipal School 3 in Yasothon City Municipality affected 267 students and staff after a lunch on June 9, 2026. By June 15, 129 individuals sought medical care at Yasothon Hospital, with 55 requiring hospitalization. Symptoms included high fever, diarrhea, vomiting, and abdominal pain, with nearly all patients recovering except for one still hospitalized. Investigations by the Yasothon Provincial Public Health Office, in collaboration with local health authorities, identified the lunch menu, 'khao moo daeng' (rice with red pork), as the likely source of contamination. Laboratory tests confirmed the presence of Salmonella spp., Aeromonas spp., Enteropathogenic Escherichia coli (EPEC), and Enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli (ETEC) at various locations within the school, including the kitchen and food preparation areas. This outbreak highlights the critical need for food safety measures in educational institutions.

triage.headline_ja: タイのE. coli：調査で食中毒の感染源が判明
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な学校での食中毒集団発生で、IHR基準は2つ未満。ただし重症度基準（複数入院例）に該当し、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 学校給食での限定的な食中毒集団発生。267人が暴露、129人が医療機関を受診、55人が入院と重症度は中程度。複数の病原菌（Salmonella、Aeromonas、EPEC、ETEC）が確認されている。国内調査は進行中だが、現在のところ国際拡大の可能性は低い。引き続き感染源の完全特定と原因究明を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis A in India: Water contamination linked to local outbreak
article.articleSummary: In Patiala, a Hepatitis A outbreak has affected 30 residents in Dogra Mohalla, with five water samples testing positive for E. coli, indicating contamination from faecal matter. The local health authorities have restored the water supply after addressing leakages, but ongoing issues with illegal connections to the main supply line persist. Civil surgeon Dr. Shelly has initiated door-to-door surveys to identify additional suspected cases, although no new jaundice cases have been reported recently. The Patiala Municipal Corporation is under scrutiny for its handling of the situation, leading to the transfer of municipal commissioner Paramjit Singh. Health minister Balbir Singh has publicly criticized the corporation's response, emphasizing the need for immediate action to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: インドのA型肝炎：水の汚染が地域的な流行と関連
triage.triage_reason: パティアラにおけるA型肝炎の集団発生で30人が影響を受け、水道水の糞便汚染が確認されている。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性と管理能力の問題が存在し、WPROスクリーニング基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: パティアラはパンジャブ州にあり、記事サマリーで確実に発生地として特定されている。水道水の糞便汚染（E. coli陽性）による引き続きの曝露リスク、違法な接続による継続的な管理課題、公式レベル（保健大臣、市長交代）での関心の高さにより、PICKUP判定。追加症例の検出と水道網の改善状況の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in India: Preventive measures initiated after confirmed cases
article.articleSummary: Rabies has been confirmed in a street dog that bit two individuals in Kumarapuram, Haripad, Kerala. The victims include a five-year-old boy and a 55-year-old man, both of whom were bitten recently. Following the incident, the dog was found dead, and a post-mortem at a veterinary lab confirmed the presence of rabies. In response, health authorities are administering anti-rabies vaccinations to all individuals who had contact with the infected dog. Additionally, the local gram panchayat is taking proactive measures by relocating stray dogs to safer centers and providing preventive vaccinations for domestic dogs and cats at a local shelter. A health-education initiative has also been launched to inform residents about rabies prevention and control.

triage.headline_ja: インドの狂犬病：確認された症例後の予防措置が開始
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の確認症例（犬から人への咬傷による2人の被害者）であり、IHR基準（異常性・公衆衛生影響）に該当。地方自治体による積極的な予防対応が実施中で、国内対応が実行中。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致命率がほぼ100%の重篤疾患であり、確認症例と接触者管理が報告されている。ケーラ州およびタミルナドゥ州での多地点での記事参照により、地理的な複数の場所での対応活動が示唆されている。スクリーニング基準5項目全て該当し、IHR基準も2項目以上該当するため、フルRRAへの進行が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis A in Thailand: Travelers advised to take precautions and get vaccinated
article.articleSummary: Thailand is currently experiencing a hepatitis A outbreak, with health authorities urging travelers to take necessary precautions. The virus is primarily transmitted through the consumption of contaminated seafood, undercooked foods, or water, and can also spread through food handlers who do not practice proper hygiene. Symptoms of hepatitis A can range from mild gastroenteritis to severe cases that may lead to acute liver failure, necessitating a transplant. Key symptoms include fatigue, loss of appetite, jaundice, dark urine, and pale stools. Unlike hepatitis B, which can lead to chronic conditions, hepatitis A results in a self-limited infection with lifelong immunity post-recovery. Vaccination is recommended for travelers, with a two-dose regimen providing long-term protection. To minimize risk, individuals are advised to ensure seafood is thoroughly cooked, drink boiled water, and choose hygienic dining options while avoiding unboiled water and contaminated ice.

triage.headline_ja: タイのA型肝炎：旅行者に予防接種と注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: A型肝炎の集団発生（アウトブレイク）が確認され、IHR基準では「異常性」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。旅行者への警告が発出されており、社会的・国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは「タイでのA型肝炎アウトブレイク」を明確に述べており、旅行者への予防接種と食品衛生対策を推奨。IHR基準4つ全て、WPRO基準5つ全てに該当する高リスク案件。フルRRA実施推奨。
